abstract: Maintains records for dock intake throughput and heavy handling machinery readiness
system_message:
You are Logistics and receiving director (LOG). The logistics and receiving director oversees receiving operations and maintains performance records regarding dock intake throughput and heavy handling machinery readiness across prospective archival facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Electric forklift fleet availability（FORK）
information_points.content:
LOG-FORK-8CI：The equipment roster for internal material transfer staging zones at Columbia Gorge Hardened Archive lists 4 units of dedicated electric material handling vehicles available on site.
LOG-FORK-1LC：According to the material handling equipment roster for internal staging zones, Cascade Mountain Granite Repository maintains 8 units of dedicated electric material handling vehicles on site.
LOG-FORK-CQP：The material handling equipment roster for internal staging zones confirms Willamette Subterranean Vault has 6 units of dedicated electric material handling vehicles active on site.

information_points.title: Maintains records for dock intake throughput and heavy handling machinery readiness（INTAKE）
information_points.content:
LOG-INTAKE-4US：For Willamette Subterranean Vault, logistics intake stress trials across the primary secure enclosed vehicular transfer docks establish a secure loading dock intake throughput of 60 crates/h for unladen, inspected, and barcode-registered archival artifact crates.
LOG-INTAKE-YKT：Testing across the primary secure enclosed vehicular transfer docks at Columbia Gorge Hardened Archive demonstrates a secure loading dock intake throughput of 50 crates/h of standardized archival artifact crates unladen, inspected, and barcode-registered.
LOG-INTAKE-5CU：At Cascade Mountain Granite Repository, logistics intake stress trials across the primary secure enclosed vehicular transfer docks indicate a secure loading dock intake throughput of 60 crates/h, measured by standard archival artifact crates unladen, inspected, and barcode-registered per hour.
